sentences.text: This fish belongs to the family Camuropiscidae within the superfamily Incisoscutoidea and the clade Coccosteomorphi.
It possessed sharp, bony plates on its mouth that formed a turtle-like beak used for cutting prey.
Its specific jaw morphology allowed it to capture and swallow prey whole.
The genus was described by Dennis and Miles in 1979.
Researchers suggest the elongated snout may have enhanced its sense of smell and improved streamlining for hunting as a pelagic predator.
It lived between 382.31 and 379 million years ago during the Frasnian stage.
Fossils were found in the Gogo Formation of Western Australia.
